Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics 23(15), 2023 (acp.copernicus.org/articles/23/8921/2023/): open burning of household waste releases particulate matter, CO, dioxins and PAHs. Fresh check this round.

National Geographic Education, Pollution (education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/pollution): dumped trash pollutes. Fresh check this round.

items.bron: National Geographic Education, Land Pollution (education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/pollution): dumping and littering add to land pollution. EEA GEMET thesaurus (eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/4636): contaminants on or in land. Oil spills and pesticides are standard causes of soil pollution. Broken glass counts as littered solid waste on the ground. That fits 'vuil grond' in the lesson's plain sense, though glass is a physical rather than a chemical pollutant. Fresh check this round.

items.bron: National Geographic Education, Pollution: pollution is the introduction of harmful materials into the environment, divided into air, water and land pollution. 'Vuil' is a fair Grade 4 simplification of 'contaminated' and includes dust and smoke, which the block names itself. Fresh check this round.

Mossel Bay municipality (pressreader, Mossel Bay Advertiser 2023-02-17): open fields, vacant land and roadsides. Fresh check this round.

items.bron: Stats SA General Household Survey 2024, as reported by ASAQS (asaqs.co.za/news/702420): about 34% of households use communal or own refuse dumps, and only 13.5% of rural households have refuse removed. A 2022 CSIR figure cited by WESSA (wessa.org.za, open waste burning in priority areas): 37% of households get no weekly collection. The claim says only 'not every', so the household and community figures settle it. Schools were not verified separately, and the claim does not depend on them. Fresh check this round.

'Party mense' is correctly narrow, because not everyone who drinks such water falls ill. Fresh check this round.

Government of Sint Maarten, Collective Prevention Services (sintmaartengov.org): old tyres and discarded containers collect rainwater and become breeding sites, and Aedes spread dengue, Zika and chikungunya. 'Party soorte' is correctly narrow. Fresh check this round.

items.bron: This is mostly a normative framing rather than a factual claim. Its factual core holds: under the National Environmental Management: Air Quality Act 39 of 2004 (lawlibrary.org.za/akn/za/act/2004/39), industrial emissions are controlled through atmospheric emission licences issued to facilities and enforced by government. That does not fall to a child. Fresh check this round.

Haldimand-Norfolk Health Unit, 'Talking to Children About Needles' (hnhu.org): tell children not to touch, and an adult handles disposal. Keep Britain Tidy: do not move needles yourself, and keep sharps such as broken glass out of litter bags. Telling a child never to handle glass is the conservative reading of that guidance and is safe. Fresh check this round.

items.bron: gov.za, Arbor Week 2025 (gov.za/ArborWeek2025): 1 to 7 September 2025, celebrated 'in the first week of September annually', run by the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment. Department of Water and Sanitation Arbor Week page (dws.gov.za/events/ArborWeek/default.asp): 1 to 7 September each year. The 2024 edition ran 29 August to 4 September (gov.za/ArborWeek2024), which still sits in the first week of September. September is now also promoted as Arbor Month. The lesson does not say otherwise, so that omission is not an error. 'Eerste' here is an ordinal date, not a ranking superlative, and it is recorded under this type so every 'eerste' in the lesson appears as an item. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: Dit was eers net een dag en het later 'n hele week geword.
items.bron: DWS Arbor Week page (dws.gov.za/events/ArborWeek/default.asp): Arbor Day was first observed in South Africa in 1983, and national government extended it to National Arbor Week in 1999. A 2006 ministerial speech (dws.gov.za, arborweek1Sep06.pdf) gives 1996, and the Mail & Guardian (2008) gives 1997. Sources disagree on the year of the extension, but every one agrees it went from one day to a week. The lesson gives no year, so the conflict does not touch it. Do not add a year without settling it. Fresh check this round.

items.bewering: suurstof: 'n Gas in die lug wat mense en baie diere inasem om te lewe.
items.bron: Leicestershire County Council, 'Why are trees important?': trees release oxygen into the air. Oxygen is the gas in air that people and air-breathing animals need. 'Baie diere' is correctly narrow, because many water animals take oxygen from water and do not inhale air. Fresh check this round.

opsomming: Every claim in all 19 blocks was checked freshly against the web, because no information about changes was given, and all of them hold. The lesson contains no ranking superlatives: 'eerste week van September' is an ordinal date and is confirmed. Its two figures of speech ('rook brand', 'maak die grond ryk') map correctly, and there is no eli10 block. The only point a person might want to know is that sources give 1996, 1997 or 1999 as the year Arbor Day became a week, so no year should be added to the sentence 'Dit was eers net een dag en het later 'n hele week geword', which is correct without one.
